concept: One imagined status update, told with the same two outlined colleagues throughout: a vague line is revised in place into something a colleague can act on, then the next step is agreed and left open for a later look. Nothing is shown as already changed.
world: A neutral stage, no governing metaphor (none passed structural fit, change and safety): a plain meeting room with one table, one status board and one quiet corner, drawn as a place with props. The same table returns at the end, changed only by the agreed action card sitting between the colleagues.
look: story-cartoon, warm paper ground, ink outline, small posed people from designed rigs (pip and tess, giver and colleague, no invented names), hand-lettered signs, round speech bubbles, halftone texture, calm faces with no exaggerated reactions. Plain diagram-led version kept as a full alternative.

devices.what: The giver's speech bubble is held at the table and revised in place (swap slot): 'I felt dismissed' stays visible, then the action line and the effect line replace and extend it. The feeling is kept, never crossed out.

One line at a time is bright with the single accent; every other line and bubble is dimmed to the field. The accent moves to the line the narration names, then the old line returns to the field family.

A hand-lettered sign 'Finish the handover first' replaces the label bubble and is held on the table across beats, relabelled (question mark, 'action + situation', 'agreed', 'look for') on the spoken word.
The opening table and the same two colleagues come back at the payoff, calm, with the action card between them and the later update still empty.
Four plain note tiles on a desk arrive on their words for the viewer's own preparation, with a separate reporting signpost kept apart. Each tile is an object, never a bullet or an icon grid.
Join material: handoff, the next field grows in from the held object. Section boundaries are hard cuts or a card, handoff only inside a topic.

value_script.accent: one warm accent on the giver's bubble
value_script.why: Pale, quiet open on the unanswered question.

value_script.accent: accent on the 'No action named' slot
value_script.why: Richer middle where the problem and the revision sit; colour moves with the line being discussed.
The single dark break is the actionability check, the key mechanism and the one emphasised moment; everything else on the board is dimmed.

value_script.accent: accent withheld on both wording cards until the answer, then on B only
value_script.why: Colour withheld so the marking after the pause is an event.

value_script.accent: none on the 'look for' box, which stays an empty outline
value_script.why: Lift for follow-up and payoff, with colour deliberately withheld from any outcome so no success is implied.

value_script.accent: accent on the action card only
value_script.why: Closing lift: the opening table returns, calm, the change still unseen.

sections.treatment: Story cartoon at the table. Hold the revision bubble and change its state on the word. Productive calm in the middle, expressive only on the opener. Camera is a slow push inside a place, cuts between places.
sections.accent_on: the line currently discussed (bubble, then action line, then effect line)
sections.world: Meeting room table, then a quiet corner away from the table for 'privately'.

beats.line: Establishing wide of the meeting room: giver and colleague at the table after a status update, 'I felt dismissed' large in a bubble, the colleague's question mark hanging over them unanswered. Subject: the vague line. Hook, story role hook.
beats.builder: bespoke (ctx.scenery room, designed rigs pip and tess); option 'acting pair'; alternatives 'illustrated bust' (hero.character_moment) and 'plain diagram' (dialogue cards)

beats.line: Wide, same two colleagues, the vague bubble held while three hand-lettered signs Act on, Next step, Revisit arrive on their words along a faint path on the table. Subject: the promise.
beats.builder: template process.flow (hybrid: held bubble, slow push)

beats.line: Medium: 'I felt dismissed' bubble lit, beside it an empty action slot left visibly blank with 'No action named'; the feeling stays, nothing crossed out. Subject: feeling versus action. Planned as drawn, upgrade_reason: a blank slot beside a held bubble has no template.
beats.builder: bespoke (swap slot beside held bubble); alternative 'plain diagram' compare.two columns Feeling and No action named

beats.line: Close on the bubble: the vague line is revised in place into 'Spoke before I finished' shown in its update setting (the handover on the status board), then 'Lost my place' added beneath; active line bright, rest dimmed. Subject: observed action and effect, content motion.
beats.builder: bespoke (held bubble, swap slot, status board prop); alternative 'illustrated bust' with dialogue card

beats.line: Wide: the two revised lines get pill labels, Observed behaviour then Impact, each on its word; a character-label bubble drifts out of frame; the colleagues are then shown alone in the quiet corner, away from the table and team. Subject: naming plus a respectful setting.
beats.builder: template document.page highlight mode (hybrid: held revised lines, push) then handoff to the corner

sections.treatment: Same pair, same table, evolving conversation. Sec2 is the peak: held proposal card relabelled on the word, one dark break for the actionability check, then a calm two card wording check as two separate scenes with a planned 3 second silent hold between them.
sections.accent_on: the proposal card and the 'action + situation' words
sections.world: Back at the table for the conversation (b06 to b08), then the next status update setting seen from the viewer's seat (b09, b10).

beats.line: Medium: the colleague's reply bubble 'I thought you had finished' appears beside the revised lines; the giver's interpretation line shifts to make room, description checked not defended, 'Their perspective' pill on its word. Subject: the recipient's account. Chapter boundary.
beats.builder: bespoke (held revision bubble plus reply bubble)

beats.line: Medium: a sign 'Finish the handover first' replaces the label bubble as the proposed next step; a small check asks 'Feasible in their role?'; a blocked path beside it is marked 'support', not a louder demand. One concise caveat, no new scenario.
beats.builder: bespoke (swap slot, held card, blocked path prop)

beats.line: Close on the held proposal card: question mark placed on it for the clear yes, then 'action + situation' lights up and a crossed out label bubble reads 'not a label'. The one emphasised moment of the film, dark break. Planned as drawn, upgrade_reason: the held card plus struck label needs a built scene, not a definition card.
beats.builder: bespoke (held card, dimmed table, one accent); alternative 'plain diagram' definition template

beats.line: POV at the next status update: two unmarked wording cards, A 'You're inconsiderate' and B 'Wait until I finish', side by side, no correct marker; pause hold of 3 seconds after the narration. Practice, subject: the two wordings.
beats.join: cut, meaning shock (a jolt into the check)

beats.line: Same two cards held: B highlighted with its action and situation parts marked, A dims with a question mark over the colleague, small note 'a proposal to discuss'. Takeaway 'Action plus situation, not a label'.

sections.treatment: Light, calm lift. A light follow-up diagram with the same colleagues, then the viewer's own preparation, then the opening table returns. No success is animated and the 'look for' box stays empty.
sections.accent_on: the agreed action; none on the 'look for' box
sections.world: A plain board with an arrow from the agreement to the later update, then a desk of note tiles, then the opening table.

beats.line: Overhead light diagram: the two colleagues agree out loud, an arrow draws to the next update, where the agreed action sits as 'Look for: handover finished' in an empty outline box, not ticked. Subject: the follow-up. Chapter boundary.
beats.builder: blueprint hero.journey (waypoints Agreed, Next update, Look for) with small posed pair; alternative 'plain diagram' process.flow

beats.line: Insert: the handshake sits beside the later update where the 'look for' box stays empty; a second note sits over any future improvement. Two equals: Agreement is not change, Later change is not proof of cause. No success animated.
beats.builder: template compare.two (pairs mode, empty side left as an outline on purpose)

beats.line: Medium on a desk: four note tiles arrive one per spoken item, Action and effect, Your question, Feasible action, Look for; a separate small signpost 'reporting process' stays apart for harassment, misconduct and safety risks.
beats.builder: template list.steps (hybrid, tiles as desk objects)

beats.line: Establishing: the opening table returns, same two colleagues calm, the handover action card between them, the later update still an empty outline; Describe, Ask, Agree, Revisit arrive in order as signs. Payoff, story role payoff.
beats.builder: avatar (allocation honoured; presenter bookend with the table station held behind)

alternatives: Plain diagram-led version: the same dialogue as flat dialogue cards, with a reaction to action contrast (compare.two), a proposed action to follow up arrow (process.flow), same check, same caveats, same sequence.
Illustrated bust version of b01, b04 and b06 using hero.character_moment or scenario.dialogue with the same lines, switchable per beat.
Acting pair (pip and tess rigs) is the planned primary; busts and plain diagram stay as options.
open_questions: Viewing context is unspecified: captions and a legible anchor per beat are assumed, no interactive player is assumed.
The 3 second silent hold in b09 relies on pass 2 sizing the pause; the pause is a hold, not an interactive stop.

b14 is allocated as avatar (presenter bookend) while the script wants the opening table with the same colleagues: pass 2 should confirm whether the avatar is a presenter beside the table or the table scene counts as the bookend.

Designed rigs only for people (no figures drawn from imagination). If a needed pose is missing (listening, agreeing handshake), pass 2 falls back to a non figurative treatment such as the card and sign alone.
b12 shows an empty box on purpose: confirm the compare.two empty side does not read as broken before render.
